machinery.note: At a full ultimate meter, turn the cone about local +Y at the ready speed; phase motion takes precedence.
machinery.limitation: Current spin scales with meter_fill and is additive with the phase row. Full-meter threshold and phase precedence need shared-driver support.

machinery.note: Spin up about local +Y during wind-up, hold full speed through flight and peak, then spin down on landing or cancellation; never bore the ground.
machinery.limitation: Current spin reaches 8 revolutions/s during windup and flight without a ramp. A 0.35 s spin-up and 0.6 s spin-down need shared-driver support.

machinery.note: Raise lens emission during wind-up and flight, flash at peak, then return to the unlit lens; the beam originates at this empty.
machinery.limitation: DrillTip is an empty, not GeometryInstance3D. This param requires P-D lens geometry and a shader consuming ultimate_fill; peak flash is deferred.

machinery.note: Open the left half of the cooling-fin V only at peak and fold it flat afterward; requires a separate fin node.
machinery.limitation: Fin.L is fused into Core; P-D must separate it. The runtime phase is flight at the ultimate_peak signal, so a peak-only row needs shared-driver support.

machinery.note: Open the right half of the cooling-fin V only at peak and fold it flat afterward; requires a separate fin node.
machinery.limitation: Fin.R is fused into Core; P-D must separate it. The runtime phase is flight at the ultimate_peak signal, so a peak-only row needs shared-driver support.

machinery.note: Breathe copper at the exhaust mouth when the ultimate meter is full; active set-piece emission takes precedence.
machinery.limitation: Exhaust.L is an empty. P-D emission geometry and ready_fill shader are required; 1 Hz breathing is not implemented by the current param driver.

machinery.note: Keep the exhaust mouth lit during the set piece and give one emission puff on landing; the stack stays fixed.
machinery.limitation: Exhaust.L emission geometry and ultimate_fill shader are required; landing puff is deferred.

machinery.note: Light the exhaust mouth during an active world-anchor haul, then extinguish it; a loaded line alone must not light it.
machinery.limitation: Disabled with scale 0: line_load means a loaded skill, not an active haul. Preserve a dark mouth until a shared driver reads the existing haul state.

machinery.note: Breathe copper at the exhaust mouth when the ultimate meter is full; active set-piece emission takes precedence.
machinery.limitation: Exhaust.R is an empty. P-D emission geometry and ready_fill shader are required; 1 Hz breathing is not implemented by the current param driver.

machinery.note: Keep the exhaust mouth lit during the set piece and give one emission puff on landing; the stack stays fixed.
machinery.limitation: Exhaust.R emission geometry and ultimate_fill shader are required; landing puff is deferred.

machinery.note: Light the exhaust mouth during an active world-anchor haul, then extinguish it; a loaded line alone must not light it.
machinery.limitation: Disabled with scale 0: line_load means a loaded skill, not an active haul. Preserve a dark mouth until a shared driver reads the existing haul state.

machinery.note: Keep the ring level and yaw it to the live aim so both barrels remain parallel to the committed beam.
Squeeze the yoke trigger once per permitted shot pulse, then release.
machinery.limitation: Zero duplicate throw: MechaMotion.shot owns the 12-degree squeeze, 0.06 s return and 0.12 s limit. A second machinery pulse would overwrite it.

machinery.note: Special-slot consumption drives the slot-2 lever throw at cast_special.contact; readiness alone must not throw it. Return after the throw.
machinery.limitation: Zero readiness rotation: the real slot_cast special row calls MechaMotion.cast at cast_special.contact, with 35 degrees, 0.08 s throw and 0.25 s return.

machinery.note: Line-slot consumption drives the slot-3 winch-lever pull at cast_line.contact; readiness alone must not throw it. Return after the pull.
machinery.limitation: Zero readiness rotation: line_skill_fired calls MechaMotion.cast at cast_line.contact. slot_cast line never plays a clip or throws the lever.

machinery.note: Haul the two-handed copper lap bar back during wind-up and retain it through flight; return on landing or cancellation.
machinery.limitation: Zero duplicate rotation: MechaMotion.ultimate_started/ultimate_ended owns the held -25-degree bar throw. A machinery turn would compete with it.

machinery.note: Use the three-step cone at class I and the five-step heavy form at class V; intermediate classes retain the base cone until their layer specifies otherwise.
machinery.limitation: Extra cone steps require P-D heft geometry. Current Drill mesh has no extra_steps shader; this param cannot change topology.

machinery.note: Grow the lens diameter with the heft layer; the corresponding beam width uses the same class fact.
machinery.limitation: Diameter ratio is 0.20/0.12. DrillTip is an empty; scaling it cannot enlarge the fused lens geometry. P-D must supply scalable lens geometry.

machinery.note: Slam this chevron panel layer into its assigned gaps on class gain and fling it out on class loss; layer holder is absent from the inspected base recipe.
machinery.limitation: P-D owns layer holder visibility and 0.18 s in / 1.2 overshoot / 0.45 s out. heft_fill is metadata until a layer shader consumes it.
